architecture_contract.unsupported_rule: Reject with ILLEGAL_INST before handler operand reads, state effects, memory effects, or TPC advance.
architecture_contract.retirement_rule: Every successful non-start/non-stop command advances TPC by its encoded instruction length; start and stop own their control transfer.
architecture_contract.argument_rule: All six B.ARG forms retain distinct three-bit argument-kind state; the dynamic form also records its decoded value.
architecture_contract.hint_rule: B.HINT records the complete encoded payload and advances the hint epoch but has no PTO-v0 scheduling effect.
architecture_contract.metadata_rule: B.DIM, B.IOR, B.IOT, B.IOS, B.CATR, B.DATR, and B.FPATR consume every decoded field into trap-preserved bundle state. After the complete bundle is collected, PTO resolves the selected direct operation's tile, scalar/address, dimension, data-attribute, fixed-point-attribute, and operation-default operands before commit.
architecture_contract.memory_rule: MCOPY and MSET accept lengths 0 through 63 bytes and reject larger XLEN values without truncation or partial effects.
architecture_contract.bridge_rule: The PTO-v0 bundle bridge resolves every canonical TileInstructionOperands field through a concrete ordered B.IOT/B.IOR resolver or explicit operation default, with raw-value decode policy recorded before constrained assignment. B.IOR GPR inputs use the fixed address, scalar0, scalar1, diagonal, flag0 order, occupy unique dense RegSrc0..RegSrc2 slots, and never exceed three inputs. Duplicate fields, duplicate assigned slots, malformed or surplus bindings reject before tile effects.
architecture_contract.matrix_postprocess_rule: CUBE complete-bundle evidence adds optional scalar QuantParam and scalar LReLUParam after the baseline logical GPR fields, and optional RowMaxIn/vector QuantParam/vector PReLUParam before D/RowMaxOut/GroupMaxOut in the compact B.IOT stream. The static mathematical operand catalog remains unchanged.
